body:
Our SDK workers set eager activity execution to true by default, iirc cloud also has this enabled by default.
In OSS server dynamic config, users might not think that this is disabled by default and never switch to true, and miss on  improvement for most use cases.

Ask: Please set default to true. Currently false: 
https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/blob/main/common/dynamicconfig/constants.go#L198-L202
Then allow users to explicitly disable it in worker config if they wish.
title: system.enableActivityEagerExecution should be true by default
